template.name: Follow Your Heart
template.entry_long: roc(open,{p0}) > {p0} and roc(close,{p1}) > {p1} and roc(high,{p2}) > 2.3 and roc(low,6) > 2.3 and roc(open,6) + roc(close,6) + roc(high,6) + roc(low,6) > 0
template.notes: The six-bar relative changes of open, close, high and low must all clear Level=2.3 with a positive sum for the long, and the mirrored sum turns negative to exit. ROC is a percentage, so the 2.3 threshold is read in percent rather than the documented price points; the account-currency profit/loss limits, 550-point stop and target, and session hours are not expressible.
